articles.summary: We introduce a new family of interpretable language models, PRISM, that enables us to trace predictions back to training data.
articles.title: PRISM: Training Data Prototypes for Language Models

articles.summary: We have developed an architecture and a training recipe for an interpretable model that is adaptable to auto-regressive and diffusion language models.
articles.title: Scaling Interpretable Language Models to 8 Billion Parameters

articles.summary: We built Atlas, an automated system for annotating Trillion-token language modeling corpora with human-understandable concepts at a sub-document level.
articles.title: Atlas: Orienting the Pre-Training data of an LLM

articles.summary: We have developed a new type of discrete diffusion language model that replaces traditional full attention with block causal attention.
articles.title: Causal Diffusion Language Models
